_about: The three kinds of secret step 1 generates, from Goffman 1956 (quotes and pages in purposes.json), each with the plain reading the prompts use. topics: the IAB tier-1 pool gated by hand, regraded 2026-09-20 under the fresh setting (the actor an ordinary adult; the firm named at step 1 only for work-ground pairs; the area name alone). Per (topic, kind): ground (work: the case sits in the actor's job at the firm; life: the firm is not mentioned at step 1 and step 3 gives Person A a job), the case the pair yields, the victim, Goffman's destructive-information test, the right-to-know test, and the verdict. Only 'keep' pairs are asked.

dark secret.quote: facts about a team which it knows and conceals and which are incompatible with the image of self that the team attempts to maintain before its audience
dark secret.plain: a fact about the actor themself that does not fit who the actor is taken to be at the firm or at home. It is the actor it would discredit.
dark secret.short: a fact about the actor themself that does not fit who they are taken to be

entrusted secret.quote: the kind which the possessor is obliged to keep because of his relation to the team to which the secret refers
entrusted secret.plain: a fact about someone else, which the actor holds because of what the actor is to the person the fact is about. The fact names that person by role, and the secret sentence names the actor's relation to them. It is that other person it would discredit or expose, not the actor.
entrusted secret.short: a fact about someone else that the actor holds because of what the actor is to the person the fact is about

strategic secret.quote: intentions and capacities of a team which it conceals from its audience in order to prevent them from adapting effectively to the state of affairs the team is planning to bring about
strategic secret.plain: something the actor, or a group the actor belongs to, has decided or is preparing to do, kept from the people it will land on so that they do not act on it first. The fact is the plan as it stands now: decided, under way, and still undisclosed when the case is told. The people kept from it are the ones it lands on, at work or at home, who would say they had a right to know.
strategic secret.short: a decision or preparation of the actor's or their group's, kept from the people it lands on until it is done

attractions.why: casino debts as money owed, a stake in a bar the firm entertains at; a colleague's debts known to a friend. Not gambling as addiction

dark secret.case the pair yields: casino or gambling losses kept from the spouse; or a stake in a bar
dark secret.verdict: keep, moderate: the case may drift to addiction, which the guard line excludes

entrusted secret.case the pair yields: a sibling's or friend's gambling debts, known and kept from that person's spouse

automotive.why: fails the two tests as yielded: a repossessed car, a DUI, an unpaid loan; a colleague's accident known to the assistant

dark secret.case the pair yields: an accident or a car bought or sold, kept from the spouse
dark secret.right to know: yes for money, but the case is an event more than a state

books and literature.why: thin: a book about the industry written under another name from firm material; nothing a reader would take for a real secret at an energy firm

business and finance.why: a stake in a counterparty; a client's insolvency known to the account manager; a deal or position being built

dark secret.case the pair yields: a personal stake in a counterparty the desk trades with

entrusted secret.case the pair yields: a client's insolvency told in confidence to the account manager

strategic secret.case the pair yields: a desk merger, book transfer or unit closure already decided

careers.why: a degree never finished; a boss's job search known to the assistant; a plan to leave, or to cut a position

dark secret.case the pair yields: a credential claimed and not held

entrusted secret.case the pair yields: a boss or mentee interviewing elsewhere
entrusted secret.victim the model picks: the manager who relies on them

strategic secret.case the pair yields: positions cut, a hiring freeze, a programme replaced
strategic secret.victim the model picks: the staff and candidates it lands on

communication.why: no fit: no standing fact about a person at the firm that someone has a right to know

crime.why: sensitive: the topic invites violent or sexual offences; the wrongdoing this mailbox can hold, fraud, a lien, a lawsuit, comes up under business and finance and law anyway

disasters.why: the true extent of storm or fire damage to the group's assets, kept from a counterparty or the trading floor

dark secret.case the pair yields: storm or fire damage to an asset logged as minor by the manager who should have written it down
dark secret.victim the model picks: the board, risk, the desk that sells the output

entrusted secret.case the pair yields: the engineer who holds the true damage survey

strategic secret.case the pair yields: the extent of damage kept from counterparties

education.why: a claimed MBA, a failed licensing exam; a colleague's failed exam known to HR

dark secret.case the pair yields: a degree or exam claimed and not held

entrusted secret.case the pair yields: one parent knows the child's expulsion or failed year and keeps it from the other parent; or a relative's degree that is not real

entertainment.why: no fit: movies, music, television: no fact of the three kinds with a victim who has a right to know

events.why: weak teeth on every kind: what the group will announce or bid at a conference or expo, kept until then

strategic secret.case the pair yields: what the group will announce at a conference

family and relationships.why: a family fact kept from the partner: a debt on the family home, a child from before the marriage; the partner is the victim. Kept after run 21 showed the area name alone yields it

dark secret.case the pair yields: a debt on the family home or a child from before the marriage kept from the partner (run 21); a second relationship

entrusted secret.case the pair yields: a sibling's separation, a parent's will, a relative's child, known and kept from the family member it touches

strategic secret.case the pair yields: a divorce being prepared, assets moved or a move planned, kept from the spouse until it is done

fine art.why: no fit: no fact of the three kinds

food and drink.why: fails the two tests as yielded: dark only: a stake in a restaurant or caterer the firm buys from; the drinking-problem case is addiction and is out

dark secret.verdict: drop: addiction, which the guard line excludes; the stake-in-a-caterer case is not what the pair yields

genres.why: no fit: film and book genres: nothing to keep

healthy living.why: sensitive where it is not thin: the plausible secrets were an eating disorder or a fitness claim, one a health condition, the other thin

hobbies and interests.why: thin: a hobby run as a business on firm time or with firm money; nothing a reader would take for a real secret at an energy firm

holidays.why: no fit: nothing of the three kinds that stands for months

home and garden.why: a house in foreclosure, a home used for a side business; a boss's house on the market known to the assistant

dark secret.case the pair yields: a foreclosure, a second mortgage or a house sold, kept from the spouse

entrusted secret.case the pair yields: the parents' house being sold, known and kept from the siblings

law.why: a lien or lawsuit against the actor; a client's or colleague's matter held by the lawyer or HR; the group's decision to sue or settle

dark secret.case the pair yields: a lien, judgment or lawsuit the role requires disclosing

entrusted secret.case the pair yields: the lawyer or HR holds a client's or colleague's matter (Goffman's own example)
entrusted secret.victim the model picks: the desk or manager who relies on the person

strategic secret.case the pair yields: the decision to sue or settle

medical health.why: a diagnosis, a pregnancy, a prescription; a colleague's diagnosis known to the assistant or the office

dark secret.case the pair yields: a diagnosis or a treatment kept from the spouse or partner

entrusted secret.case the pair yields: a parent's diagnosis known to one child and kept from the others, or a partner's kept from the family

personal celebrations and life events.why: an engagement broken off, a marriage to someone at a counterparty; a colleague's pregnancy known to a friend

dark secret.case the pair yields: a marriage or engagement kept from the parents; a pregnancy kept from the partner
dark secret.right to know: moderate: the partner yes, the parents arguable

entrusted secret.case the pair yields: a friend's pregnancy or broken engagement

personal finance.why: a debt, a bankruptcy, a garnishment, a second mortgage; a colleague's garnishment known to payroll

dark secret.case the pair yields: a debt, a bankruptcy, a garnishment, a loan kept from the spouse

entrusted secret.case the pair yields: a parent's insolvency known to one child and kept from the siblings; a friend's debt

strategic secret.case the pair yields: savings moved or a resignation planned, kept from the spouse
strategic secret.verdict: drop: the natural case is family and relationships, strategic

pets.why: no fit: nothing with a right to know

politics.why: weak teeth on every kind: strategic only: the group's position on a rule, kept from the regulator or a partner; the dark case, a political role or donation, is the person's belief and is out

pop culture.why: no fit: celebrity news: nothing to keep

real estate.why: land the actor owns where the firm will build; a client's property in foreclosure; a site purchase, a lease given up, a floor sublet

dark secret.case the pair yields: a building defect logged as minor (run 16); land the actor owns where the firm will build
dark secret.victim the model picks: the buyer in due diligence, or the firm

entrusted secret.case the pair yields: the assistant knows the SVP's private deal with a counterparty (run 16)

strategic secret.case the pair yields: a floor sublet or an office move, kept from the landlord (runs 15, 16)

religion and spirituality.why: sensitive: a person's belief, and nobody at the firm has a right to know it

science.why: an emissions or soil test the actor sat on; a test result an engineer is entrusted with; the group's own forecast or survey

dark secret.case the pair yields: an emissions or soil test result the engineer sat on

entrusted secret.case the pair yields: the engineer entrusted with a test result kept from the plant manager

strategic secret.case the pair yields: the group's forecast or survey kept from a partner

shopping.why: thin: vendor gifts kept from the manager; personal purchases on the firm card; nothing a reader would take for a real secret at an energy firm

dark secret.case the pair yields: spending or credit cards kept from the spouse
dark secret.verdict: drop: the natural case is personal finance, dark

sports.why: thin: sports betting; a paid role with a sponsor; nothing a reader would take for a real secret at an energy firm

style and fashion.why: no fit: nothing with a right to know

technology and computing.why: a software side business, an outage the actor caused; a colleague's mail known to the administrator; a platform or system plan kept from a partner

dark secret.case the pair yields: an outage the actor caused and logged as a vendor fault; a side business sold to the firm's vendors

entrusted secret.case the pair yields: the administrator knows of a breach, told to keep it from the desk

strategic secret.case the pair yields: a platform plan kept from a partner

travel.why: personal trips billed to the firm, travel to interviews; a boss's real destination known to the assistant; a trip to a rival for talks

dark secret.case the pair yields: personal trips billed to the firm

entrusted secret.case the pair yields: the assistant knows the boss's real destination
entrusted secret.victim the model picks: the manager who relies on him

strategic secret.case the pair yields: a trip to a rival for talks

war and conflicts.why: sensitive, and no fact of the three kinds with a right to know at the firm
